basic.description:
{Basic Eagle Eye}

Basic Eagle Eye gives your hero a 40% chance to learn any 1st or 2nd level spell used in combat and reduces spell mana cost by 1.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Eagle Eye}

Advanced Eagle Eye gives your hero a 50% chance to learn any spell up to 3rd level used in combat and reduces spell mana cost by 2.

expert.description:
{Expert Eagle Eye}

Expert Eagle Eye gives your hero a 60% chance to learn any spell up to 4th level used in combat and reduces spell mana cost by 3.
